observations.observation: Read the full candidate. A mixed-vehicle/cooperation gap motivates redesign of cellular-automaton states and rules, preceded by explicit spatial/time discretization. A single-lane FollowingModel supports a MultilaneModel; lane changes require both speed motivation and safety conditions, with distinct human/autonomous rules. The reported near-tripling concerns replacing all conventional vehicles, while the dedicated-lane threshold is unnamed here and must not borrow another paper's value. Seattle comparison then imposes a strong limit: autonomous vehicles reduce a capacity deficit but do not cure it, leading to combined dedicated lanes and widening at narrow sections.
